name: badge
title: Badge
description: A word or two of status. The text is the meaning, a distinct shape per tone backs it up, colour comes last. Quiet is text with a hairline rule; warm is a hand-inked outline in the tone's ink; playful is a chip of colour with a kolam flower on the corner. Busy badges breathe or turn, never in quiet or under reduced motion.
